meta.title: Pro Ocean Ocean Van MVP
meta.author: Pro Ocean
meta.description: Öffentliche MVP-Demo der Buchungs- und Tourenplanung für den Ocean Van

steps.data:
<?php
/** MVP-Schutz: Keine E-Mails aus der temporären Demo versenden. */
add_filter('pre_wp_mail', '__return_true');

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

update_option('blogname', 'Pro Ocean · Ocean Van MVP');
update_option('blogdescription', 'Buchung und routenoptimierte Tourenplanung');
update_option('timezone_string', 'Europe/Berlin');
update_option('admin_email', 'demo@proocean.example');
update_option('pov_email_sender_address', 'demo@proocean.example');
update_option('pov_team_notification_emails', 'demo@proocean.example');

\ProOceanVan\Activation::enableTestProfile(true);
update_option('pov_geocoding_provider', 'demo');
update_option('pov_routing_provider', 'null');
update_option('pov_demo_mode', '1');
$states = [];
foreach ((new \ProOceanVan\Repository\StateRepository())->all() as $state) {
    $states[(string) $state['state_code']] = [
        'is_active' => 1,
        'sort_order' => (int) $state['sort_order'],
    ];
}
(new \ProOceanVan\Repository\StateRepository())->updateStates($states);
(new \ProOceanVan\Service\DemoDataService())->seed();

$page = get_page_by_path('ocean-van-demo');
$pageId = $page instanceof WP_Post ? (int) $page->ID : wp_insert_post([
    'post_title' => 'Hol dir das Meer zu dir',
    'post_name' => 'ocean-van-demo',
    'post_type' => 'page',
    'post_status' => 'publish',
    'post_content' => '[pro_ocean_van_booking]',
]);
if ($pageId && ! is_wp_error($pageId)) {
    update_option('show_on_front', 'page');
    update_option('page_on_front', (int) $pageId);
}
